kate: Quick async — evening train status check (cut window in ~2h). Short list: canary looks healthy, two cherry-picks in flight, one potential blocker. Posting current plan and asks.

omar: Canary metrics steady p50=120ms, p95=310ms, errors 0.2% over last 10m :thumbsup:

liam: Cherries: #789 (kv-cache fix) — needs infra LG; #800 (tokenization edge-case) — flaky windows tests. I'm looking at #789 now.

ana note: whoops — name typo fixed. ana: @liam I can repro #800 locally, started a debug run on `staging-800`. Will attach logs if I see the same stack.

ci-bot: [CI] Build triggered: PR #800, PR #789. Links: https://ci.internal/runs/789, https://ci.internal/runs/800

liam: Quick update: #789 likely needs a one-line change in `serve/runtime/prefix_cache.py` to avoid double-key write. Will open patch in ~15m. Might block merging before cut.

jordan: I have the dedicated slot reserved 22:00-02:00 UTC for the rollout. If #789 doesn't land, we can still cut other commits and gate the specific change behind `hold-for-789` label.

kate: Decision proposal: hold the full cut for up to 30m while we try to get #789 green. If not, proceed with other commits and exclude PRs labeled `hold-for-789`. @omar can you set a fallback routing policy in case canary regresses?

omar: Done — routing policy `train-evening` updated to fallback to `model-v2-quant` with 10% fallback for first 10m.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary rollout at 22:10 UTC. Rollout will skip PRs with label `hold-for-789`.

ana: Small operational note: log-retention job burst is throttling S3 writes right now, eng-sre alerted. Not blocking cut unless it spikes; keeping an eye.

liam: Patch pushed for #789, retriggering CI. Diff includes: 
``
- _cache[k] = v
+ _cache.setdefault(k, v)
```

ci-bot: [CI] Build #789 — success :white_check_mark: (logs: https://ci.internal/runs/789)

jordan: Merged #789 into main; removed `hold-for-789` from queued PRs.

kate: Cut is green, proceeding with canary at 22:10. Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone :tada: If anything odd pops up, ping #eng-oncall and I'll coordinate rollback.

liam: Thanks all — I'll follow the canary and watch for KV cache anomalies.

omar: Will monitor metrics and post a 22:20 status update.

ci-bot: [Notification] Canary rollout started at 22:10 UTC.
